“Elevating Events. Defining Luxury.”

This Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement (“Agreement”) is entered into between
HMP Luxury Event Services (“HMP,” “Company,” “we,” or “us”) and the Client identified below
(“Client,” “you,” or “your”).

This Agreement outlines the services, responsibilities, payment terms, and conditions
associated with the Client’s Guest Seating Experience booking.

2. GUEST SEATING EXPERIENCE
The Guest Seating Experience is an interactive digital seating solution designed to provide
guests with a convenient and seamless way to locate their assigned table.

Depending on the package selected, the service may include:

   ●   Digital guest seating directory
   ●   Guest name search functionality
   ●   Assigned table lookup
   ●   27”/32” Premium LED Signage
   ●   Customized event imagery and/or branding
   ●   Digital display setup and installation
   ●   On-site setup and removal

The exact services provided will be based on the package selected and reflected on the Client’s
invoice or service order.




3. SELECTED SERVICE
Input information for service being provided




4. GUEST SEATING INFORMATION
Client is responsible for providing HMP with an accurate and finalized guest seating list.

The seating information should include, as applicable:

   ●   Guest first and last name
   ●   Table number/name
   ●   Seating assignment
   ●   Any relevant grouping or seating information

Final Guest Seating List Due: ___________________________

HMP will use the information provided by the Client to create the digital guest directory.

Any changes submitted after the agreed-upon deadline may be subject to additional fees and
may not be guaranteed.




5. CLIENT-PROVIDED INFORMATION
Client is responsible for ensuring that all guest names and seating assignments are accurate
before submission.

HMP is not responsible for errors resulting from inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated information
provided by the Client.

Once the final guest directory has been approved by the Client, any subsequent changes may
require additional preparation time and/or an additional fee.




6. CUSTOMIZATION & EVENT AESTHETIC
Where applicable, HMP may customize the Guest Seating Experience and/or Premium LED
Signage to complement the Client’s event aesthetic.

Customization may include:

   ●   Event colors
   ●   Monograms
   ●   Names
   ●   Logos
   ●   Photographs
   ●   Graphics
   ●   Event-specific imagery
   ●   Personalized welcome or seating messages

Client is responsible for providing any logos, photographs, graphics, or other materials they wish
to incorporate.

HMP reserves the right to determine whether submitted materials are suitable for the selected
display format.

7. PREMIUM LED SIGNAGE
The Premium LED Signage will be used to display the approved event content and/or guest
seating information.

Premium LED Signage may be provided on a podium or standalone display stand,
depending on the package selected.

Any specific display structure, backdrop, easel, stand, or additional décor included with the
service will be identified on the Client’s invoice or service order.




8. SERVICE SETUP & ACCESS
Client agrees to provide HMP with reasonable access to the event venue for setup, testing, and
removal of equipment.

Scheduled Setup Time: _________________________________

Scheduled Removal Time: _______________________________

The Client is responsible for coordinating with the venue regarding access, loading areas,
parking, elevators, electrical access, and any venue-specific requirements.

If HMP is unable to access the venue at the agreed-upon time due to circumstances outside of
HMP’s control, setup or service delays may occur.




9. ELECTRICAL & VENUE REQUIREMENTS
Client is responsible for notifying HMP of any venue restrictions that may affect the service.

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Client is responsible for ensuring that an appropriate
electrical source is available for equipment requiring power.

Any required venue permits, insurance requirements, electrical requirements, or additional
venue fees are the responsibility of the Client unless otherwise stated in writing.

10. PAYMENT & RETAINER
A 50% non-refundable retainer is required to secure the Client’s event date and services.

The remaining balance is due according to the payment schedule stated on the Client’s invoice.

The event date is not considered secured until the required retainer has been received
and this Agreement has been accepted by HMP.

Total Service Fee: $____________________

50% Non-Refundable Retainer: $_________________________

Remaining Balance: $____________________

Final Payment Due: ______________________




11. PAYMENT METHOD
HMP Luxury Event Services currently accepts payment through the payment method(s)
identified on the Client’s invoice.

Any applicable payment processing fees, returned payment fees, or other charges will be the
responsibility of the Client.




12. CANCELLATION & RETAINER
The non-refundable retainer is used to reserve the Client’s event date and secure HMP Luxury
Event Services’ availability.

If the Client cancels the booking twenty (20) days or more prior to the scheduled event date,
[Insert Event Date], any unpaid balance may be waived. However, any retainer or other
payments previously made will remain non-refundable, unless otherwise required by applicable
law or expressly agreed to by HMP in writing.

If the Client cancels after the stated cancellation deadline, the Client will not be eligible for a
refund and may only request to reschedule the services for a different event date, subject to
HMP’s availability and approval.

Rescheduling after the cancellation deadline is not guaranteed, and the new event date must be
confirmed in writing by HMP. Additional fees may apply depending on the new date, services
requested, or other applicable circumstances.




13. RESCHEDULING
Requests to reschedule an event must be submitted to HMP Luxury Event Services in writing at
least twenty (20) days prior to the Client’s scheduled event date, [Insert Date].

Rescheduling requests are subject to HMP’s availability and the availability of the requested
services, equipment, or rental items. A rescheduled event date must occur within one (1) year
of the original scheduled event date.

A request to reschedule does not automatically transfer or guarantee the Client’s booking to the
requested date. The new event date must be confirmed in writing by HMP before the
rescheduling is considered approved.

Requests submitted less than twenty (20) days before the scheduled event date may be
considered on a case-by-case basis and are not guaranteed to be accommodated.

HMP will make reasonable efforts to identify an available date; however, rescheduling is subject
to HMP’s availability and is not guaranteed. If HMP is unable to provide an available date within
one (1) year of the original event date, the Client will not be entitled to a refund of the retainer or
any other payments previously made, unless otherwise required by applicable law or expressly
agreed to by HMP in writing.

Any additional fees resulting from the rescheduled date, changes in services, equipment, rental
items, or other applicable circumstances will be the Client’s responsibility.




14. Rush Booking, Cancellation & Rescheduling

If the Client books services thirty (30) days or less, the booking will be considered a Rush
Booking and may be subject to a Rush Fee, determined based on the event date, service
requirements, scope of work, customization needs, equipment requirements, and preparation
time available.

For Rush Bookings, full payment is due at the time of booking in order to secure the event
date and services.

If the Client cancels a Rush Booking after payment has been received, no refund will be
issued. The Client may only request to reschedule the services, subject to HMP Luxury Event
Services’ availability.

Rescheduling is not guaranteed and is subject to the availability of HMP, the requested
services, equipment, and rental items. Any rescheduled event date must occur within one (1)
year of the original scheduled event date.

If HMP is unable to identify an available date within one (1) year of the original event date, the
Client will not be entitled to a refund of any payments previously made, unless otherwise
required by applicable law or expressly agreed to by HMP in writing.

Any additional fees resulting from the rescheduled date, changes in services, equipment, rental
items, or other event requirements will be the Client’s responsibility.




15. EQUIPMENT & PROPERTY
All HMP equipment, including but not limited to LED displays, stands, kiosks, tablets,
computers, cables, accessories, and related equipment, remains the property of HMP unless
otherwise stated in writing.

Client agrees not to move, modify, tamper with, or allow unauthorized individuals to operate
HMP equipment.

Client may be responsible for repair or replacement costs resulting from damage caused by the
Client, guests, venue personnel, vendors, or other unauthorized persons.




16. GUEST USE OF EQUIPMENT
Guests may interact with the Guest Seating Experience as intended by HMP.

Client agrees to notify guests that equipment should be handled with care.

HMP is not responsible for damage caused by guests or other event attendees.




17. TECHNOLOGY & SERVICE INTERRUPTION
HMP will make reasonable efforts to ensure that the Guest Seating Experience is operational
and available during the agreed service period.

However, HMP cannot guarantee uninterrupted operation in circumstances involving:

   ●   Power failure
   ●   Internet or network interruption
   ●   Venue restrictions
   ●   Equipment malfunction
   ●   Severe weather
   ●   Third-party technology failures
   ●   Acts beyond HMP’s reasonable control

HMP will make reasonable efforts to troubleshoot or provide an appropriate alternative when
possible.




18. FORCE MAJEURE
HMP shall not be considered in breach of this Agreement for delays or failure to perform caused
by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to severe weather,
natural disasters, government restrictions, venue closures, transportation disruptions, power
outages, labor disruptions, equipment failures, or other unforeseen circumstances.




19. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES
Client agrees to:

   1. Provide accurate guest and seating information.
   2. Meet all submission deadlines.

3. Provide required event materials and branding in a timely manner.
   4. Provide venue access for setup and removal.
   5. Inform HMP of venue rules and restrictions.
   6. Ensure guests and vendors do not intentionally damage HMP equipment.
   7. Make all required payments according to the agreed schedule.




20. HMP RESPONSIBILITIES
HMP agrees to:

   1. Provide the services outlined in the Client’s selected package.
   2. Prepare the Guest Seating Experience using the information provided by the Client.
   3. Complete setup and testing within the agreed service window, when venue access is
       available.
   4. Make reasonable efforts to ensure the system is operational during the contracted
       service period.
   5. Provide professional assistance consistent with the services purchased.




21. PHOTOGRAPHY & MARKETING
Unless the Client opts out in writing, Client acknowledges that HMP may photograph or record
its equipment and general event setup for portfolio, marketing, website, and social media
purposes.

HMP will make reasonable efforts not to use identifiable images of guests without appropriate
permission.

Client Marketing Consent:

☐ I agree to HMP using event setup images for marketing purposes.

☐ I do not agree to HMP using event setup images for marketing purposes.




22. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
HMP shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from
the use or inability to use the Guest Seating Experience.

HMP’s liability shall not exceed the amount actually paid by the Client for the specific services
giving rise to the claim, except where prohibited by applicable law.




23. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement, together with the Client’s invoice, service order, and any written addenda,
constitutes the entire agreement between HMP and the Client regarding the Guest Seating
Experience Services.

Any changes to this Agreement must be made in writing and agreed upon by both parties.

Any applicable payment processing fees, returned payment fees, or other charges are the

6. CANCELLATION & Retainer
The **non-refundable retainer** is used to reserve the Client’s selected rental items, secure the
Client’s event date, and reserve HMP Luxury Event Services’ inventory for that date.

If the Client cancels the rental booking **fifteen (15) days or more prior to the scheduled event
date, [Insert Event Date]**, any unpaid balance may be waived. However, any retainer or other
payments previously made will remain **non-refundable**, unless otherwise required by
applicable law or expressly agreed to by HMP in writing.

If the Client cancels **less than fifteen (15) days prior to the scheduled event date**, **no refund
will be issued for any retainer, deposit, or other payments previously made**, and the Client will
remain responsible for any applicable fees or costs already incurred by HMP in connection with
the rental.

**All cancellations made within the fifteen (15) day period are final and non-refundable.**




7. RESCHEDULING
Requests to reschedule must be submitted to HMP in writing **fifteen (15) days or more prior to
the scheduled event date, [Insert Event Date]**.

A rescheduled rental is subject to:

   ●   HMP availability
   ●   Availability of the requested rental items
   ●   Applicable price differences
   ●   Any additional delivery, setup, or transportation fees

HMP does not guarantee that the same rental items will be available for a new date.




8. Rush Booking, Cancellation & Rescheduling
If the Client books **Celebration Accessories Rental services thirty (30) days or less prior to the
scheduled event date**, the booking will be considered a **Rush Booking** and may be subject
to a **Rush Fee** based on the event date, rental items requested, preparation requirements,
and time available to fulfill the order.


For Rush Bookings, **full payment is due at the time of booking** to secure the rental
reservation.

All rental accessories are **subject to inventory availability for the Client’s specific event date**.
An item being displayed in HMP Luxury Event Services’ collection, website, catalog, or
promotional materials does not guarantee that the item will be available for the Client’s event
date.


If a requested accessory is unavailable, HMP may offer the Client an alternative item of
comparable style, quality, or value, subject to availability and Client approval.


If the Client cancels a Rush Booking after payment has been received, **no refund will be
issued**. The Client may only request to **reschedule the rental**, subject to HMP’s availability
and inventory.


Any rescheduled rental date must occur **within one (1) year of the original scheduled event
date** and is subject to the availability of the requested rental items.


If HMP is unable to provide an available rental date and/or the requested rental items within one
(1) year of the original event date, the Client will **not be entitled to a refund of payments
previously made**, unless otherwise required by applicable law or expressly agreed to by HMP
in writing.


Any additional fees resulting from the rescheduled date, changes in rental items, delivery
requirements, setup, or other circumstances will be the Client’s responsibility.




9. CONDITION OF RENTAL ITEMS
All rental items are provided in good, clean, and usable condition unless otherwise disclosed to
the Client before the rental.

Client agrees to inspect the items upon receipt and notify HMP of any significant issue before
using the items.

If the Client does not report an issue within a reasonable period after receiving the items, the
items may be presumed to have been received in acceptable condition.

10. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITY & CARE OF
ITEMS
Client is responsible for the rental items from the time they are delivered or made available to
the Client until they are returned to HMP or collected by HMP.

Client agrees to:

    ● Handle all rental items with reasonable care.
    ● Keep items in a safe and secure location.
    ● Prevent unauthorized persons from damaging or removing items.
    ● Use items only for their intended purpose.
    ● Not modify, alter, paint, cut, glue, permanently attach materials to, or otherwise alter
       rental items without written permission from HMP.
    ● Protect items from excessive moisture, heat, fire, food, beverages, or other conditions
       that could cause damage.




11. DAMAGE, LOSS & THEFT
Client is financially responsible for rental items that are:

    ●   Lost
    ●   Stolen
    ●   Damaged
    ●   Destroyed
    ●   Permanently altered
    ●   Returned with excessive damage beyond normal wear and tear

The Client may be charged the reasonable repair or replacement cost of the affected item.

If an item can be repaired, HMP may charge the reasonable repair cost.

If an item cannot reasonably be repaired or restored, HMP may charge the replacement value of
the item.




12. NORMAL WEAR & TEAR

The Client will not be responsible for ordinary wear and tear resulting from normal and proper
use of the rental items.

HMP will determine whether damage exceeds normal wear and tear based on the condition of
the item before and after the rental period.




13. CLEANING & ALTERATIONS
Client may not permanently alter or modify rental items.

Unless specifically stated in the rental order, Client should not:

   ●   Apply adhesives
   ●   Use permanent tape
   ●   Staple or nail materials
   ●   Paint or dye items
   ●   Cut materials
   ●   Attach decorations using methods that may damage the item

Any cleaning or restoration costs resulting from improper use may be charged to the Client.

If the Client requests a custom-to-rent accessory, production will begin according to the terms

Custom orders require a minimum of two (2) months for production, unless otherwise

Custom rental items may require additional deposits, production fees, or non-refundable
payments.

The Client acknowledges that custom items may have slight variations from reference images
due to materials, production methods, availability, and handmade or customized elements.




20. Additional Custom-To-Rent Acceriores
Process
**.Customized requests may require a **design proof or concept for Client review and

specifications, colors, materials, or other applicable details before HMP proceeds with the

Any changes requested after final approval may result in additional fees and/or affect the

Due to the customized nature of certain items, **some customized or specially sourced rental

non-refundable payment or cancellation restriction will be **clearly identified on the Client’s
invoice before the order is confirmed**. The Client acknowledges that customized items may
require advance purchasing, production, sourcing, or preparation specifically for their event and
agrees to the applicable terms stated on the invoice.

All rental items are subject to availability.

27. HMP RESPONSIBILITIES
HMP agrees to:

   3. Communicate applicable delivery, pickup, or return requirements.
   4. Make reasonable efforts to accommodate the Client’s approved rental specifications.
   5. Communicate material changes affecting the Client’s rental when reasonably possible.
